definition.title: LEGO® Fun!
definition.description:
Lots and lots of Legos®... Seriously, a lot.

This program is held every third Sunday of the month at Bascom.

Create something cool? We can display a photo of it on the library's LCD TV! Ask staff and we'll take a photo of it.

For children and families. Registration recommended but not required.

Important: Children under 5 must be accompanied by their parents as small LEGO® pieces can be choking hazards. 

ADA Accommodation Requests

Lego by Alexander Lowe

Amazing Vehicles by Rona Skene

definition.title: Sunday Crafternoon: Painted Pumpkins
definition.description:
That's right, we're celebrating decorative gourd season for our November Sunday Crafternoon!

Just in time for your Thanksgiving decoration needs, we'll have mini faux pumpkins and a variety of mark-making supplies for you to customize these objects to your preferred holiday vibes. While we wait for paint to dry, we'll also craft fake acorns for a bonus decorative element.

This project is best for ages 7 and up. Adults are strongly encouraged to join us and get their craft on. Younger participants may need the assistance of a grown-up or older sibling.

Supplies are limited, registration required.

Sunday Crafternoon: calabazas decoradas

¡Así es! ¡En nuestro Crafternoon (tarde de manualidades) del domingo de noviembre celebraremos la temporada de las calabazas decorativas!

Justo a tiempo para decorar tu hogar para el Día de Acción de Gracias, tendremos mini calabazas artificiales y una variedad de materiales para decorarlas a tu gusto y darles el estilo festivo que prefieras. Mientras esperamos a que seque la pintura, también decoraremos bellotas artificiales como detalle adicional.

Esta actividad es ideal para niños de 7 años en adelante. ¡Invitamos especialmente a los adultos a participar y disfrutar de esta divertida actividad! Los participantes más pequeños requerirán la ayuda de un adulto o de un hermano mayor.
